the immediate valences of similar sugars can be distinct from the long-term salience of those sugars, and that a distinct subset of neurons may generate these different reward representations.

the immediate valance of a reward is often different from its long-term salience, and that the immediate valances and long-term salience of rewards are encoded by different sensory neurons.
